Summary.Name: DeepCoro_CLIP generic
Summary.Description: Predict stenosis severity and blockage percentage, predict calcification severity only, predict CTO severity and predict thrombus severity from angiograms.

Mechanism.Outcome: Predict stenosis severity and blockage percentage, predict calcification severity only, predict CTO severity and predict thrombus severity
Mechanism.Output: Probability of stenosis and severity of stenosis

Model.Purpose: Classify stenosis and predict severity of stenosis, calcification, CTO and thrombus
Model.Output: Probability of stenosis and severity of stenosis, calcification, CTO and thrombus

Uses_and_directions.General_use: This model can be used to classify stenosis and predict severity of stenosis, calcification, CTO and thrombus from angiograms.
Uses_and_directions.Target_population_and_use_case: This model is intended for use in the cardiac imaging field to assist in the diagnosis of stenosis and predict severity of stenosis, calcification, CTO and thrombus.
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: Before using this model, please ensure that the input data is in the correct format and that the model is trained on the appropriate data.

Warnings_and_limitations.Image_Quality: The model requires high-quality angiograms with clear visualization of the coronary arteries, calcification, CTO and thrombus.
Warnings_and_limitations.Multiple_Devices: The model is designed to classify multiple coronary arteries in multiple videos, calcification, CTO and thrombus.
Warnings_and_limitations.Confidence_Scores: Current threshold applied on probability output for classification is defined in class_mapping.json
